chunks: And through its chain of narration, from the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family)
He said: The best of the women who ride camels are the women of Quraysh, who are the most gentle/kind to their husbands.
ai.seo_question: What characteristic makes a woman the 'best' according to this hadith from the Prophet?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq records this tradition in *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, linking the virtue of gentleness (hina) to the Quraysh, a tribe historically associated with nobility and leadership in pre-Islic and early Islamic Arabia. This narration underscores that marital excellence is defined not by status but by emotional warmth and kindness toward one's spouse, a quality highly valued in Shia ethical teachings.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-253 According to the same documentation, the Prophet (S) said, “
The best of the women of the Quraysh (tribe) who ride camels are the ones who are kind to their husbands.”
